title: Implement local PostgreSQL init, migrations, and readiness
verify: Local PostgreSQL init script creates or verifies database/user for DATABASE_URL idempotently.
Migration command path can run and report status against configured local PostgreSQL.
/ready proves DB connectivity when DB readiness is enabled.
Rollback-safe test session remains available for feature tests.

verify.summary: Local PostgreSQL init passed dry-run and two full runs for idempotence; migration dry-run and full migration passed with current/head revision at base; opt-in /ready DB smoke returned 200 with database ok; PostgreSQL public schema contains only alembic_version; targeted database tests passed with 10 tests; broader Foundation backend tests passed with 21 tests; .venv database subset passed with 10 tests; mb-lint, mb-doctor, and git diff --check passed. Full T2 protocol and required packet/spec gates are satisfied.

evidence_required: DB init/migration transcript or safe local dry-run evidence
constraints: Do not create product domain rows or product tables beyond migration baseline needs.
Do not hardcode local credentials outside .env/.env.example conventions.
Output must redact credentials and auth material.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model is mutable runtime authority.
timeline.jsonl is audit/export only, not mutable runtime authority.
purpose: Make the local database and migration path executable before product tables and routes are implemented.
success_outcome: Feature tasks can add migrations and DB-backed services without redefining local database setup or readiness behavior.
anti_goals: No hosted database or cloud sync.

forbidden_scope: server sync or hosted database assumptions
stop_conditions: Local PostgreSQL bootstrap cannot be made idempotent.
Migration command would require destructive database operations.
Readiness behavior would leak credentials or protected details.
